# Class: `PreferencesDialog`

Edits application preferences and the default sample metadata schema.

[Module](API-Module-icescopy-aux.md) · [Source](../src/icescopy_aux.py#L918) · [API index](API-Reference.md)

**Bases:** `QDialog`.

Sample-field changes have their own validation and dropped-value confirmation. Preference persistence and applying settings to the live window are separate operations; see the preference tests before changing their order.
